title: Standard F1b Bernedoodles (Dora)
temperament: loyal, smart, playful, energetic, sweet, love to cuddle, incredibly friendly with other dogs, cats, and kiddos.
cardDesc: Meet our Standard F1B Bernedoodles out of Dora and Bamboo, bred for gorgeous low-to-non-shedding coats and gentle, family-ready temperaments. These pups bring together the best of both worlds, Dora’s sweet nature and Bamboo’s sharp intelligence making them ideal lifelong companions.
